label: rem:molecular-assembly-projector-remark
title: The assembly projector as a q-Young symmetriser
html: The assembly projector e_{\lambda,\mu} is the q-Young symmetriser for the pair (\lambda,\mu). Benzene is the case e_{(2,2,2),(6)} (benzene as the assembly projector), whose symmetric block is realised geometrically as the T(2,6) threading link.
heading: Remark
